document.title: News from social media
document.question:
An increasing number of people now get their news mainly from social media rather than from newspapers, television or radio. Some value the speed and variety of online news, while others worry about its accuracy.

Why is this happening? Is this a positive or negative development?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
